en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,

(The narrator) says, ‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man commited a crime upon me. Shall I excuse him from it, or raise it to the authorities?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is your right. If you were to excuse from it, so it is better, and if you were to raise it to the Imam<sup>asws</sup>, so rather you would be seeking your right, and how would it be (dealt) for you by the Imam<sup>asws</sup>’.
